name: Document Library
description: A document-management system built on a custom "document" content entity with hierarchical folders, per-document version history, favorites, download tracking, search, and a granular permission set.
project_description: Document Library (dl) provides a self-contained document-management system for Drupal 10/11. It defines a custom "document" content entity (base table `document`) with a required file field, an owner, a published flag and a download counter, and organizes documents into a hierarchical folder tree stored in the custom `dl_folders` table with slug-based nested URLs under /documents. It ships a front-end library UI (browse, folder pages, search, favorites, per-document view with version history), an admin listing at /admin/content/documents with bulk publish/unpublish/delete, per-document version history (`dl_versions`), download logging with user/IP/timestamp (`dl_downloads`), user favorites (`dl_favorites`), and a 12-permission access model with owner-plus-"manage all" overrides. Configuration lives in the `dl.settings` config object (items per page, feature toggles, theme); file constraints (extensions, 50 MB max, storage scheme) are governed by the standard File field on the entity via Field UI.
